# UX Requirements Checklist: Vocabulary Word Actions

**Purpose**: Review whether the requirements completely define personal vocabulary actions, persistence, recovery, and accessibility
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are star requirements defined for both directions, persistence, ordering, and retained encounter data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are known-word requirements defined for removal, future suppression, persistence, and recovery? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK003 Is the difference between CEFR highlighting and personal known-word suppression explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Are exact important-word ordering rules specified for both starred and unstarred groups? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Scenario and Edge Coverage

- [ ] CHK005 Are rapid actions, starred-to-known transition, older-data migration, invalid retained data, and capacity boundaries addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is accidental known-word dismissal recoverable without modifying active saved words? [Recovery, Spec §FR-009–FR-010]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK007 Are accessible name, state, keyboard focus, tooltip, glyph, and non-colour requirements present for every action? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-003, FR-008, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Are local-only retention, collection bounds, migration, minimum-width layout, and least-privilege boundaries defined? [Privacy/Scope, Spec §FR-011–FR-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation.
- These items assess requirements quality, not the finished implementation.
